channel_identity_source: Set channel labels and numbers for this experiment before analysis
exposure_gain: Not specified; record acquisition settings for this experiment
replicate_structure: Not specified; record the experimental design before interpreting comparisons
analysis_unit: usable nucleus from the selected nuclear channel

nuclear.threshold_rule: median(smoothed nuclear channel) + max(5 ADU, 4 * 1.4826 * MAD(smoothed nuclear channel))

foci.background_method: grayscale opening of smoothed channel with disk(radius=12, decomposition=sequence); approximate disk footprint from scikit-image
foci.noise_method: Per-nucleus robust diagonal first difference: MAD((I00-I10-I01+I11)/2) / 0.67449; implemented as 1.4826*MAD. Approximate smoothed noise = raw noise/(2*sqrt(pi)*sigma).
foci.threshold_rule: Each threshold is max(channel floor, multiplier * estimated smoothed noise); identical rule across all images and nuclei within a channel
foci.post_watershed_rule: Retain basin pixels above max(support threshold, 0.25 * basin peak), keeping only the connected component containing the peak
foci.contrast_filter: raw focus mean - local background median >= 2 * per-nucleus raw noise; no circularity, eccentricity, or aspect-ratio exclusion
foci.annulus_exclusions: outside same nucleus; any provisional focus pixels dilated by 1 pixel
foci.annulus_fallback: remaining same-nucleus nonfocus pixels (>=20); otherwise median opening background over focus and per-nucleus raw noise
foci.nuclear_edge_rule: Foci constrained to usable nucleus; boundary-touching foci retained and flagged
foci.sensitivity_rule: Multiply support, seed, prominence, and net-mean-noise thresholds uniformly; keep all other parameters fixed

measurements.corrected_intensity: Original unsmoothed pixel intensity minus opening background; negative values retained
measurements.local_corrected_intensity: Original intensity minus local background median; negative values retained
measurements.circularity: 4*pi*area_px/perimeter_crofton_px^2; raw value retained, not clipped at 1
measurements.relative_radial_position: distance_to_nuclear_centroid_um / (distance_to_nuclear_centroid_um + nearest_nuclear_boundary_distance_um); 0 center, approaching 1 at edge
measurements.coordinates: zero-based pixel-center coordinates; X=column, Y=row; calibrated X,Y use respective pixel dimensions
measurements.zero_focus_cells: count, density, occupied area, integrated totals = 0; per-focus means, medians, maxima and morphology = missing
measurements.calibration: ImageJ unit=micron; X/Y pixel size = reciprocal TIFF X/YResolution; use X and Y separately
measurements.projection_limitation: 2D projected objects and areas; overlapping Z foci cannot be separated; stored spacing is not used to infer volumes
measurements.saturation: value == 65535 for uint16 container; detector effective bit depth unavailable

qc.interpretation: Manual inspection flags only; no image exclusions; dataset-relative flags are heuristic

statistical_testing: None; descriptive measurements only. Define biological replication before any inferential testing.
template_note: Starting numerical settings inherited from the pilot pipeline. Review calibration, marker labels, nuclear size limits, and channel-specific thresholds for each experiment.
